entries.title: One field under each card, with a Chat button beside its choices
entries.body: A card now has a single field above its buttons, labeled anything to add?. Press Enter or Chat to send what you wrote as a reply without choosing. Click any other button and your words go with that choice. A past card shows the words you sent with your choice.

picture.alt: A decision card with one field holding a short note above its Not now, Lock the plan and Chat buttons, Chat lit at the right edge.
